meta.title: GRN Photo / Document Attachment: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Navigate to a GRN and verify that GRN Photo / Document Attachment is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.
Repeat the GRN photo/document attachment flow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it succeeds.
Compare the same Warehouse Executive user's capability across the Growth and Enterprise tenants.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Navigate to a GRN and verify that GRN Photo / Document Attachment is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.; Repeat the GRN photo/document attachment flow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it succeeds.; Compare the same Warehouse Executive user's capability across the Growth and Enterprise tenants.

args.need: sign in as a Warehouse Executive, test GRN Photo / Document Attachment on the Growth tenant and the Enterprise tenant, and verify that Growth refuses or hides it while Enterprise allows it

steps.note: No catalog step can reach the GRN workflow, attach a document or photo, identify plan availability, or compare the two tenants.
Closest available assertion that the requested capability is visible after the tester completes the Enterprise-side check; it does not establish the Growth-side refusal.
